title: OMEGA core-country minister identity pool
scope: Exactly the 197 ISO3 country identities in resource_country_resource_context_index.json, resolved through countries.json. Other territory and geographic-only entries remain in countries.json and are not silently presented as core-country ministers.

generation.description: Profiles are generated deterministically on demand from existing OMEGA minister templates. They are fictional simulation characters, not verified real-world ministers.
